atlasDisposition: No productization. OFR5 Atlas remains research navigation evidence; exact owner refs are escape hatches.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Does not imply one universal temporal schema. Effective time, knowledge time, authority epoch, generation and task revision remain owner-native.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: A materially different owner safely rewrites current state while preserving all historical/PIT/currentness decisions without extra semantics.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No new Core sentence. Retain OFR2 as independent support.
candidateDecisions.name: Non-rewriting Temporal Truth
candidateDecisions.reason: A10/A18 already preserve history vs currentness without owner-schema centralization.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Shared semantic inequality only; each owner defines its own unknown causes and recovery action.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Binary/terminal collapse matches recovery/decision quality across Runtime, Finance, World, Security and Human without false action or added reconciliation.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Add one sentence to A10 only; no Unknown object/schema/service.
candidateDecisions.name: UNKNOWN Is a First-Class Action State
candidateDecisions.reason: A-grade five-owner evidence generalizes UNKNOWN beyond lost Effect responses; current Core implies but does not state the action-state non-collapse broadly enough.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Does not require identical projection data structures or a central view service.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Derived/copy views safely become mutation/semantic authority across independent consumers without drift/stale truth/duplicate ownership.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No new law or projection service.
candidateDecisions.name: Projection Is Not Authority
candidateDecisions.reason: A6 and primitives §7 already state selected/derived views do not acquire source authority.

candidateDecisions.boundary: No universal identity tuple follows; each owner must name its non-bypassable invariants.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Label/byte/revision sameness alone predicts safe continuity across materially different owners better than invariant-bound identity.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Tighten primitives Contract only: identity follows owner-named meaning-bearing invariants; labels/bytes/revisions alone are neither necessary nor sufficient. Strengthen Knowledge examples.
candidateDecisions.name: Identity Is Bound to Relevant Invariants, Not Labels or Bytes
candidateDecisions.reason: A-grade identity evidence now spans Run, financial instrument, network path, authority/key and Runtime operation; Core lacks the compact negative sufficiency statement.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Does not define one universal Knowledge object or promotion daemon.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Simple recurrence/retrievability reliably predicts stable reusable authority without scope/falsifier across heterogeneous knowledge families.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No Knowledge/Promotion daemon or new Core law.
candidateDecisions.name: Evidence Availability Is Not Knowledge/Promotion Authority
candidateDecisions.reason: A14/A18 already separate evidence/retrieval from promotion and current world-model admission.

candidateDecisions.boundary: No single permission/effect object should own all stages; ownership remains domain-specific.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Collapsing these stages creates no false positives or unsafe actions across repeated external-effect domains.
candidateDecisions.name: Capability, Authority, Commitment and Consequence Are Distinct
candidateDecisions.reason: A2/A7/A8/A9 already decompose capability, authority, commitment, dispatch/effect and consequence truth.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Deletion is not a universal default for participant-owned data, legal records, unique evidence or irreversible external state.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Repeated deletion tests mainly recreate work and do not reveal responsibility boundaries or smaller invariants.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No audit registry or new deletion service.
candidateDecisions.name: Contraction and Deletion Are Epistemic Operators
candidateDecisions.reason: A11/A14 already make deletion/contraction active epistemic/admission operators while preserving history.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Simulation/reversibility cannot substitute for real social/economic/adversarial consequence evidence.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Prevention-heavy workflows dominate reversible probes at equal discovery/recovery cost, or reversible tests systematically mispredict consequential reality.
candidateDecisions.name: Reversibility Expands Search, but Recovery Does Not Erase Consequence
candidateDecisions.reason: A8/A9/A10 already separate reversible exploration, durable consequence, UNKNOWN/reconciliation and historical fact.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Some failures may legitimately begin in a lower layer; the rule is causal localization, not mandatory sequential edits.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: A materially different consumer independently reproduces the pressure ladder, or early lower-layer change repeatedly beats truthful higher-layer resolution in total cost.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Keep in Research and treat A13 as the current Core burden-before-layer rule.
candidateDecisions.name: Consumer Pressure Determines Layer Admission
candidateDecisions.reason: Grade C evidence shares recent Computing methodology; strict first-successful-layer descent has not independently generalized.

candidateDecisions.boundary: No universal option-value scalar or retain/delete rule is supported.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Current-use-only retention dominates option-aware reasoning across repeated low-reacquisition/high-uncertainty environments, or the distinction never changes decisions.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Strengthen adaptive-change-capitalization §6; no Core law or option-value engine.
candidateDecisions.name: Current Use, Option Value and Capability Value Are Distinct
candidateDecisions.reason: Current-use, option value and capability value are reusable cross-owner distinctions, strengthened by World R10, but no universal scalar/retain rule is supported.

candidateDecisions.boundary: No global observation threshold; new capability/cheap evidence may reopen the frontier.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Continued search after the current stop condition repeatedly yields decision-changing evidence at favorable cost, or stopping predictably misses high-value branches.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No stopping threshold/service. Existing Knowledge may cite evidence but no Core mutation required.
candidateDecisions.name: Stop When Further Evidence Cannot Change the Current Decision
candidateDecisions.reason: A15 already assigns judgment the decision to stop when exploration has diminishing returns; cross-owner evidence independently supports rather than extends the responsibility.

candidateDecisions.boundary: A central mechanism is still justified when a truly unowned non-bypassable responsibility recurs and deletion breaks multiple workloads.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Multiple domains repeatedly suffer greater cost/drift from owner-local mechanisms and one shared mechanism preserves all invariants at lower total cost.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No central implementation follows from recurrence.
candidateDecisions.name: Shared Semantics Do Not Imply Shared Mechanism
candidateDecisions.reason: A13 already states shared semantics require unowned non-bypassable responsibility and deletion evidence before shared mechanism.

candidateDecisions.boundary: This is a recoverability requirement for causal theory, not a mandate for one eight-field schema or eager default context.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Winner-only summaries support equal held-out transfer/deletion decisions without extra archaeology or unsupported inference.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Expand causal-responsibility-explanation with causal-history recoverability; no eight-field schema.
candidateDecisions.name: Causal theory must preserve defeated alternatives, not only the winner
candidateDecisions.reason: OFR3 reconstruction plus OFR4 winner-only holdout show negative causal history is reusable, but the detailed rival/falsifier/counterfactual recipe would bloat Core.

candidateDecisions.boundary: This does not forbid one owner from implementing several decisions in one product; it forbids treating a theory sentence as automatic evidence/action authority.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: A one-bit reopen target is unambiguous across evidence sufficiency, research reopening and owner mechanism admission.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Record explicit distinction in Knowledge explanation, not a new Core law.
candidateDecisions.name: Theory reopen conditions are not evidence or admission authority
candidateDecisions.reason: A2/A10/A18 already separate theory/world-model claims, owner evidence and action/commitment authority; OFR4 measurement failure provides new support.

candidateDecisions.boundary: This is about knowledge/navigation surfaces; an owner may still expose a canonical current projection when it actually owns that fact.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Index-only/shared-law surfaces match exact local causal/currentness decisions with no overgeneralization at lower cost.
candidateDecisions.mutation: No TheoryDB/Atlas truth layer. Retain owner-local causal escape hatches.
candidateDecisions.name: Navigation is not causal truth or current owner truth
candidateDecisions.reason: A6/A13/A18 already separate projection/navigation/shared synthesis from owner current truth and local semantics.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Only mechanically owned facts qualify; semantic judgments, evidence sufficiency and domain meaning remain with their owners and may require reasoning.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Fresh consequential workloads reconstruct these facts from prose with equal reliability/cost, or projection causes more staleness/authority errors.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Add guidance to causal-responsibility Knowledge only; no Core mandate or metadata schema.
candidateDecisions.name: Mechanically knowable truth-role/currentness/authority should be projected, not regenerated
candidateDecisions.reason: OFR5 mechanism diagnostic plus ACS3 support mechanically projecting known truth-role/currentness/authority; useful but still surface/consumer-sensitive.

candidateDecisions.boundary: This does not say concise representations are bad; it rejects byte/word reduction as a sufficient compression metric.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Payload size alone reliably predicts lower total accepted-answer cost at equal fidelity across held-out consumers.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Add receiver-conditioned compression section to Knowledge; no Core law.
candidateDecisions.name: Compression is receiver-conditioned and must be judged by total cognitive cost
candidateDecisions.reason: EX3-EX7 + OFR4/OFR5 show byte/word compression can shift cost into receiver reconstruction/extra turns/failure; A11 already holds the Core net-cost principle.

candidateDecisions.boundary: Treatment/model/corpus-specific; not a universal document or memory chunking law.
candidateDecisions.falsifierOrReopen: Fresh consumers/models select minimal roles reliably and reduce failure-adjusted total cost without causal loss.
candidateDecisions.mutation: Keep OFR5 case-level hydration as conservative research constraint only.
candidateDecisions.name: Complete causal case is the current conservative hydration unit
candidateDecisions.reason: Explicitly corpus/model/treatment-specific; per-role overfetch is real but not yet a reusable cross-owner law.

coreMutationBudget.principle: Evidence should make existing Core more precise before it makes Core larger.

decisionAuthority: Computing synthesis under frozen OFR6 promotion contract; does not establish owner-current truth or action authority.
knowledgeMutations: Strengthen adaptive-change-capitalization identity and option-value sections using cross-owner evidence.

Expand causal-responsibility-explanation with negative causal history, reopen/evidence/admission separation, navigation/truth separation, mechanical metadata guidance and receiver-conditioned compression.

retiredSharedForms.reason: OFR4 holdout falsified recovery of rival/falsifier/counterfactual/boundary. Preserve as negative control evidence only.

retiredSharedForms.name: causal-kernel/minimal-chain as universal canonical packet
retiredSharedForms.reason: OFR4 compressed treatments failed frozen semantic non-inferiority; do not keep an active canonical packet shape.

retiredSharedForms.reason: OFR5 failed physical reliability and failure-adjusted cost gates; retain only research evidence.

retiredSharedForms.reason: OFR5 supports it as locator only; causal-role/ref fidelity was insufficient.

retiredSharedForms.name: CENTRALIZED_LAWS as owner-local causal history
retiredSharedForms.reason: OFR5 strongly falsified exact case/history/ref recovery and showed overgeneralization.
